institutionName: UiT The Arctic University of Norway

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: the nature

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was easy enough, just a lot of information and "biokratic" stuff you needed to do

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Wasn't relevant, but there was for sure a lot of different opportunities to get help if needed

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: nice with the weekly emails with information on activities and stuff happening

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: For me I easily got through samskipnad, but I know others who didnt get any (afterall) and it was very chaotic and late information about this

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Socially it very much depends on who you get housing with - some places are very social and some are veryyyy not-social. some places are clean, some not. and not be rude, but often some "strange" slash not-talking-at-all people at the housings

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It really changed from person to person and place to place, but I was very happy with mine and got some good friends! was happy that there both were norwegian and internationalt students

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Easy enough, but again a lot you needed to do - and also on different systems, one for the Erasmusprogramme one and some on the universities own one

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: dont remember, just followed erasmus process. strange system with the course registration???? you needed to get in contact with the teachers on the course to get on it...

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: a lot i think if needed

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: NOT. a lot was declined:( appartently a lot are closed for other students except exactly the ones on the studyprogramme belonging to the course...:(

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: nothing , there is a lot of help if needed

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Often very little school? but otherwise very satisfied (and nice having so much sparetime, now being on exchange)

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: medium, but mostly easy

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: A lot of time off. not much needed to be done. very easy

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: HIS-1023 Samisk og Kvensk historie fra 1850 og fram til våre dager. BIO-2005 Biologiske ressurser i nord. BIO-3015 Arctic marine system ecology and climate change

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
BIO-2005: Mega fed 5-dages ekskursion til alta!!!!.
HIS-1023: Synes rigtigt nice fag, og lærte meget om historien. Også en 2-dages ekskursion.
BIO-3015: Hvis man vil lære en masse spændende om arctic ocean lærer man en masse, meget skole/forelæsninger!
